lines: In accomplished but in tanmayatva-state in fruit, by putraka-sādhakas
to another, from that pair to either, that is offered.
l4.sanskrit_cite: siddhe tu tanmayībhāve phale putrakasādhakaiḥ anyasmai taddvayādanyatarasmai tatsamarpyate
